source: Pilot v2 (2026-11-26): realistic delay, Tony's appearance protocol, measured-scale camera uncertainty

rationale.delay: Real arm: commands ~2.3-3.3 steps late (servo dead time + compute), joint reads ~0.4 ms (on time), camera frames 1-2 steps old. Train commands 1-3, joints 0, camera 0-2, plus 10% of episodes with no delay. The v1 ranges (each 0-2 independently) left the randomized policies at 0% without delay.
rationale.appearance: Tony's visual protocol (gloss, surface tones, light direction/intensity/colour, camera exposure/white balance/noise/blur) replaces texture swaps and the weak lighting factor: the validation drop was on exactly these variants.
rationale.camera: Pose/FOV jitter cut to about the measured-calibration uncertainty (v1 used +-1.1 cm / +-2.3 deg at full strength).
